snippet.title: Crown and Adventure — Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Demo Is Now Available - Overwhelmingly Positive Reviews! 
Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3098140/Crown_and_Adventure/
Wishlist Crown and Adventure and subscribe to our social channels for updates!
X: https://x.com/C3D_Games
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/KU6uuWmD9m
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CrownandAdventure/

Beneath your feet lies Eulogize - once a divine land, now the Circle of Calamity. Tread carefully, traveler. Every misstep could be your last.

Three mighty nations dominate this land:
Chen-Yuan Empire at the heart, where imperial authority reigns supreme through disciplined armies and rigid battle formations.
Caucaid in the east, a patchwork of seven duchies united under solar faith, blending magic with emerging technologies.
Sasin Dynasty in the west, remnant of the Ancient Empire where desert sands guard secrets, ruled by holy descendants and priests.

Power manifests differently across realms: Chen-Yuan Ascender's Ki, Caucaidian Mage's Mana, Sasin priest's summon power. Yet fragile peace persists amidst border conflicts and historical grudges - until now.

A greater threat is lurking at the heart of the land. The Demonspawn from the Circle of Calamity - Blazespawn, Grimspawn, and Spitespawn - are attempting to seize this land. Their hostility towards mankind has never waned. The fifth blaze cataclysm is approaching...

When old enemies must unite against annihilation, will your blade tip the balance? Every spell, every alliance, and every choice shapes Eulogize's fate. The age of crowns and chaos begins.

#rpg #open-world #crownandadventure #trailer #indiegame #gamedev
